g.text: Kalman filter innovations and the chi-square (NIS) test

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; fill: #666666

g.text: Innovation = GPS minus the filter's IMU-based prediction (east/north combined). NIS = squared innovation weighted by its predicted covariance (4 degrees of freedom); threshold set for 1 false alarm per flight-hour on training and validation flights.
